sources.title: UNMOVIC, Notes on factors that have shaped Iraq’s policies on weapons of mass destruction (6 March 2003)
sources.note: Indexed original opening historical paragraphs:1921 state,1932 independence,1958 republic,1968 Baath,1979 Saddam presidency,1980 to 1988 war. Direct PDF failed. Use historical chronology only; no claim that pre-invasion assessments prove2003 weapons stocks.

sources.title: US Office of the Historian, Iraq: recognition and diplomatic relations
sources.note: Direct original institutional chronology, mandate ending1932, July1958 coup, invasion20March2003 and CPA transfer28June2004. Diplomatic recognition1930 is not the end of mandate1932.

sources.title: Human Rights Watch, Genocide in Iraq: The Anfal Campaign Against the Kurds (1993)
sources.note: Direct original report summary: captured government documents and over350witness interviews, systematic destruction/disappearances and1988 campaign. Omit contested exact death estimates and distinguish Halabja from the operational Anfal campaign.

sources.title: UN Office of the Iraq Programme, About the Oil-for-Food Programme
sources.note: Indexed original institutional account:1990 invasion and sanctions;1991 humanitarian mission;1995 resolution986;first exportsDecember1996 and foodMarch1997. No simplistic single-cause child-mortality statistic.

sources.title: Iraqi Council of Representatives, Constitution of Iraq, Arabic
sources.note: Original parliamentary text indexed, direct403. Article11 exact بغداد عاصمة جمهورية العراق . Query site:iq.parliament.iq "المادة (١١)" "بغداد". Distinguish current digital reproduction from original2005 printed document. Do not use Investment Commission Arabic page: its numbering diverges from final text.

sources.title: WIPO Lex, Iraqi Constitution (2005), English text
sources.note: Direct complete text:Articles1,3,4,11,117. WIPO legislation metadata10027 identifies2005constitution. English and parliamentary Arabic versions grouped as one work. Transliteration supplied editorially.

sources.title: OPEC, anniversary of the Baghdad founding conference (14 September 2021)
sources.note: Indexed original anniversary statement:Al-Shaab Hall,10 to 14September1960, five founding members and Talaat al-Shaibani. Different dated anniversary work from2022statement used inSaudi card; rerun budgets.

sources.title: UNESCO, Traditional craft skills and arts of Al-Mudhif building, inscription01950 (2023)
sources.note: Indexed original full description; direct human verification. Reed/papyrus arches, community construction/mats, tribal sheikh management, guests/weddings/dispute discussion and learning. Regional marshland tradition;2023listing not invention date.

sources.title: UNESCO, Iraqi Maqam, inscription00076
sources.note: Indexed original full text also resolves under stale guqin-art-00076 slug. Correct numeric listing is Iraqi Maqam, proclaimed2003/listed2008. Instruments, improvisation, Arabic poetry and social venues; no present concert-frequency claim.

sources.title: UNESCO Courier, Architectural lessons for the future, via the past (2019)
sources.note: Indexed original architectural discussion:projecting carved lattice windows called shanasheel/roshan inIraq, airflow and sun protection. Shared regional architecture inherited by modern Iraq; not a1945invention or all-home description.

sources.title: FAO, Dhuhaa Najm Shith’s dairy enterprise in Nineveh (7 March 2021)
sources.note: Direct full first-person account:buffalo feed/water,before-sunrise milking,qimar/raw milk city markets,and planned kitchen rehabilitation/equipment. Avoid source’s contradictory cream/cheese labels by using thick cream, and do not call planned units complete.

sources.title: FAO, Threat to Iraqi marshes and buffalo producers (14 July 2022)
sources.note: Indexed original field-mission report,July2022 low water,fodder shortages,declining milk and family relocation. Explicit snapshot; no claim all marsh families left.

sources.title: UNDP Iraq, Investing in education, investing in Iraq’s future (23 January 2023)
sources.note: Full indexed original account of Mujahid al-Arabi Primary School,al-Karma,Anbar,Saif12,and Mohammad13. Direct page failed. Clear contrast of temporary rooms to rehabilitated classrooms/library/toilets/drinking water, no nationwide success generalization.

sources.title: UNESCO, Al-Nouri Mosque restoration and archaeological discovery
sources.note: Direct full page:2014Daesh,2017explosives,autumn2018preparations,2021excavations,four12th-century probable ablution rooms,Atabegcoins,jars,carvedstone,1940s reconstruction. Ancient rooms are a modern archaeological discovery, not modern construction.

sources.title: WHO Eastern Mediterranean Region, Polio eradication: Iraq
sources.note: Indexed original country programme account:twoBaghdad2014cases,coordinated campaigns,2020resumption1.7millionchildren. Card confines statement to2014response, not an unchecked permanent current disease status.

sources.title: UNICEF Iraq, Flooding leaves thousands at risk of water-borne disease in Northern Iraq camps (9 January 2019)
sources.note: Full indexed original report datelined27November2018,published9January2019;Qayyarah/Jeddah/Airstrip camps,sewage flooding,water restoration,desludging and school handwashing image. Scoped to displaced families in this emergency.

sources.title: WHO Eastern Mediterranean Region, Iraq situation updates2015
sources.note: Indexed original Highlights20October to 15November2015:clinic of6caravans in displaced-person camp onNajafroad inKerbala,lab/pharmacy/dressingroom/maternal-childunit. Intended5000beneficiaries omitted rather than represented as measured outcome.

proposedOverrides.name: Iraq
proposedOverrides.summary: Modern Iraq links diverse urban, farming and marshland communities with oil diplomacy, changing governments, conflict, research and rebuilding.

batchIdentityNotes.decision: Only exact modern indexed Iraq record; do not alias Mesopotamia(GB),Abbasid,Ottoman or ancient Mesopotamian states.
batchIdentityNotes.map: Index1945 to present. Five decoded features:1945 to 1960,1960 to 1994,1994 to 2000,2000 to 2010,2010 to 2020. Stable broad footprint cannot represent wartime territorial control or federal internal boundaries.
batchIdentityNotes.geometry: Baghdad,Basra,Mosul,Erbil,Sulaymaniyah,Najaf,Karbala,Nasiriyah inside all5;KuwaitCity,DeirEzZor,Khorramshahr outside all5. See place-checks.json. No proposed polygon repair.
